findings.description: The QueryView digest basis is circular and response-scoped after the C21/C23 edits. C5 is unchanged and still hashes 'sorted source IDs/revisions/coverage', but C3 gives the view a Coverage, C21 now nests universe:ResultUniverse inside Coverage, and C23 gives ResultUniverse a source_view_digest back-reference, so the digest can be an input to its own preimage; Option and UniverseBasis hint at an escape but nothing states it, and C23 explicitly puts a universe on the live view. ResultUniverse also carries per-request values (applied_limit, columns/columns_digest, rows_complete_for_selection, bounded_by_input, basis), so hashing it transitively makes the view digest change with --limit or --columns, collapsing C10's deliberate split between view digest and normalized request digest and mis-firing its StaleCursor rule on ordinary pagination. Placement is contradictory: C21 nests universe inside Coverage while C19 and query-contract.md both list universe beside coverage in the data envelope, with C23 saying only that serializers preserve it. Finally the basis binds neither SourceSelection (C22) nor ContentAccess retained-field capability (C21) although C23 says the view records both, so selection enters only incidentally through coverage counts and two views differing only in retained fields can share a digest while execute_view must refuse widening to unavailable fields. Minimal fix: restate C5's basis as an explicit closed list over view-scoped inputs only, including SourceSelection and ContentAccess retained-field capability, excluding ResultUniverse, cursors and next actions by name; then resolve the placement in one direction across C19, C21 and query-contract.md. Belongs in the wave0 freeze set before team/baseline.dd.json is sealed, since C21's own rule returns a changed shared field to tk-0001 and invalidates dependent proof.
